# QR generator

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python implementation from Project Nayuki,
version 1.8.0, distributed under the MIT license included in the file.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/python/qrcodegen.py

It generates QR codes locally. No packages, CDN or QR service are required.
